verdict.rationale: Zulip has a documented REST API (e.g. 'Send a message') and a bot framework, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, a changelog, feature levels, or a deprecation policy. Basic API existence does not show versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
